mission.goal: Converge CIOS onto an exact-head, failure-first, provider-attested production path while preserving the A1 capital-intelligence authority ceiling and preventing premature production promotion.
mission.user: Kim Kagiso Mosiane and authorised Federation Omega operators
mission.workflow: Admit exact source; run the complete CIOS and adversarial suites; build an immutable image; deploy zero traffic through an authorised private route; read back identity, digest, health, persistence, restore and rollback; promote only after independent target-bound evidence passes the production gate.
mission.data: Tenant-scoped capital-intelligence events and classified evidence metadata; provider receipts contain bounded identifiers and digests but no credentials.
mission.interface: Authenticated HTTP provider candidate exposing exactly health, readiness, release verification and bounded event ingestion; document routes remain disabled.
mission.stack: Python 3.12 standard library reference runtime; SQLite is containment-only; managed PostgreSQL and immutable external audit are required for production.
mission.environment: Local deterministic qualification now; private Cloud Run candidate after trusted OIDC and provider target binding are available.
mission.governance: Formation-gated A1 local build; no financial effects, external communication, deployment, merge or traffic promotion in this build action.
mission.failure: Fail closed on source drift, route drift, caller identity override, parser budgets, conflicting or future evidence, self-attestation, unknown adapters, persistence uncertainty, failed canaries, missing rollback or provider readback.
mission.testing: Complete CIOS unit suite, rc7.1 OOXML adversarial suite, provider concurrency and identity regressions, Phoenix bridge admission, release verification and MODISA v3.3 validation.
mission.deployment: Not executed: the live Federation operator has no CIOS deployment action, no bound admin token is available, and managed persistence plus provider identity remain unproven.
mission.continuity: Resume from the exact admitted pull-request head; preserve immutable test receipts and require the same image digest through zero-traffic canary, promotion and rollback readback.

assumptions.stack: The deterministic CIOS domain engines remain reusable; only the provider shell and proof plane are hardened.
assumptions.runtime: Python 3.12 with no third-party parser dependency in the reference build.
assumptions.storage: SQLite proves local semantics only; production requires an existing authorised managed transactional database and immutable evidence store.
assumptions.authentication: The reference candidate binds one configured tenant and runtime principal; production requires independently verified enterprise OIDC/IAP/IAM claims.
assumptions.deployment: A private zero-traffic deployment may run only through a live-allowlisted CIOS action using short-lived provider identity and zero new recurring cost.

components.frontend: NOT_APPLICABLE: CIOS production convergence is an API and proof-plane build.
components.backend: Fail-closed Python HTTP provider candidate with an exact four-route profile and 256000-byte request ceiling.
components.database: SQLite reference store serialized per process; managed PostgreSQL adapter remains required before production traffic.
components.queue: NOT_APPLICABLE: no asynchronous provider queue is enabled in this source cut.
components.worker: Bounded in-process OOXML parser; a resource-isolated parser worker is required before provider document routes can be enabled.
components.scheduler: NOT_APPLICABLE: no autonomous scheduled effects are introduced.
components.cache: NOT_APPLICABLE: provider proof is always read back and never promoted from cache.
components.storage: Classified metadata vault and hash-chain audit are local references; immutable object evidence and retention-locked audit remain provider gates.
components.authentication: Constant-time bearer check bound to a configured single tenant/principal; caller tenant/user overrides are denied.

observability.correlation_ids: Event IDs, idempotency keys, evidence control IDs and provider artifact references.
observability.health_checks: Authenticated /health and /ready expose local semantic health while explicitly denying provider-deployment proof.
observability.structured_logs: Provider structured logging and trace correlation remain a production qualification control.
observability.audit_logs: Local hash-chain audit is verified on health; immutable external audit remains required.
observability.metrics_alerts: Provider availability, latency, error, auth-denial, persistence, backup and audit alerts remain required before promotion.

testing.unit: CIOS domain, tenancy, authority, ingestion, gate, data-plane and release suites.
testing.integration: Real local HTTP canary, 64-way serialized provider requests, reopen persistence and audit-chain validation.
testing.e2e_or_smoke: Release verifier and Phoenix Airlock bridge execute the complete internal CIOS test court.
testing.fixtures_mocks: Deterministic provider bindings, independent verifier callbacks, bounded OOXML archives and tenant fixtures.
testing.failure_first: Late/encoded DTDs, archive bombs, route drift, oversized requests, identity override, classification downgrade, future/conflicting/self-attested evidence, unregistered adapters and concurrent writes.

setup_commands: No additional dependency installation is required for the stdlib reference suite.
deploy_commands: NOT_AUTHORIZED_IN_THIS_BUILD: invoke only a future live-allowlisted CIOS zero-traffic operator action after managed persistence and trusted identity are bound.
rollback_commands: Future provider pipeline must restore the exact prior Cloud Run revision traffic map and prove semantic health; failed first deployment must remove only the new exact service.
delivery.debugging: Keep production_claim=false; inspect the failing unit, exact source SHA, provider binding, receipt verifier, target digest and rollback checkpoint; repair and rerun the full admission court.

watchman.unavailable_capability: The healthy live Federation operator exposes no CIOS deployment action; trusted provider identity, production database, immutable audit and rollback receipts are not bound.
watchman.safe_substitute: Produce and admit the exact secure source candidate, keep document and consequential routes closed, and stop before deployment or traffic promotion.

continuity.idempotency: Event ingestion requires stable occurred_at and supports idempotency keys; future deployment uses unique revisions and exact digest binding.
continuity.checkpoints: Exact Git SHA, test receipt, MODISA contract validation, image digest, prior traffic map, provider target binding, zero-traffic canary, persistence restart, restore and rollback receipts.
continuity.resume_conditions: A CIOS action is live-allowlisted; a trusted short-lived identity can read and mutate the exact target; an existing managed database and immutable audit sink are bound; full CI is exact-head green.
continuity.stop_switch: No production qualification without an exact target and independent verifier; any failed, invalid, future, stale, self-attested or conflicting control blocks promotion.

proof.test_results: Local rc7.1 court PASS: 233/233 complete internal CIOS tests; 20/20 provider, security and Phoenix admission tests; release verifier passed as 1.0.0-rc7.1 with production_claim=false; MODISA v3.3 validation passed. Exact-head GitHub CI remains pending.
proof.deployment_readback: NOT_APPLICABLE: no authorised CIOS provider mutation or deployment occurred.
proof.semantic_verification: Local tests prove bounded parsing, exact provider route/body parity, fixed-tenant bearer containment, conflict/future/self-attestation rejection and classification-downgrade denial. They do not prove provider identity, horizontal persistence or production recovery.
unresolved_defects: Managed PostgreSQL or equivalent transactional production persistence adapter is not implemented or provider-proven.
Immutable external audit, malware/DLP, enterprise OIDC, observability, backup/restore and rollback are not provider-proven.
Container digest pinning, SBOM, signature, provenance and vulnerability admission are not yet enforced.
Resource-isolated parser worker is required before provider document routes may be enabled.
Live Federation operator has no CIOS deployment action and no bound admin token in this execution context.

builds.scope: rc7.1 bounded OOXML ingestion and archive defenses
target-bound independently verified production qualification gate
exact provider route/body profile, fixed-tenant identity and serialized SQLite candidate
provider IaC, zero-traffic release and rollback proof
quarantine, malware/DLP and isolated document processing plane
